question: Who among the following sultans of the Delhi Sultanate appointed Ghiyasuddin Balban as his/her Prime Minister?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Nasiruddin Mahmud**__.

__
 
• **Nasiruddin Mahmud appointed Ghiyasuddin Balban as his Prime Minister.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Nasiruddin Mahmud**

 
 
• He was the **son of Iltutmish**.
 
• He was known as the ***Darvesi King***.
 
• He appointed Ghiyasuddin Balban as his Prime Minister.
 
 
 
• **Balban:**
 
 
• He ruled from 1266 AD-1287 AD.
 
• He was a member of **Chahalgani Chalisa.**
 
• He **broke the power of Chahalgani **and restored the prestige of the crown.
 
• He created a strong centralised army and established the military department ***Diwan-i-Arz.***
 
• He took up the title of ***Zil-i-Ilahi*** (a shadow of God) and impressed upon the people that the king was the deputy of God (***Niyabat-i-Khudai***).
 
• He insisted on the Iranian ceremonies of ***sijda and paibos.***
 
• Balban **started the festival of Navroz**.
 
• He adopted a policy of blood and iron.
 
• He was a patron of Persian literature and showed special favour to** Amir Khusro.**
 
 

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**

 
• **Shamsuddin Iltutmish** introduced the** silver coin (tanka) **and the **copper coin (jital)**.
 
• **Razia Sultan **was the** first and last Muslim woman ruler of Medieval India.**
